notes.title: Release Date Set! 🎊
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers! 👋

We are excited to announce that Shopkeeper Simulator is launching on Steam this summer! ☀️

Open the doors to your shop on July 22, 2025! 🎊

[previewyoutube=iWmw2sX1Hmc;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager and build your retail empire from the ground up.  Whether you’re starting with a small shop or dreaming of a bustling supermarket, every decision you make will shape your success! 🏬

This is going to be the hottest release this summer! 🥵 Get ready now and add Shopkeeper Simulator to your Wishlist ✅ so you don't miss the premiere! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/765c71d14cff053de031a15b3854a1b3b2e39773.gif

Join us on July 22, 2025 and experience the thrill of running your own supermarket! We can promise hours of addictive, rewarding gameplay in the full version of the game! 😎

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34912963/c1f5a123a1c0cee520604fb90aff524e08896828.png

See you at the grand opening!
Shopkeeper Simulator Team
